title: Unramifiedness at a rational point is surjectivity on cotangent spaces
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a morphism locally of finite type between schemes over a field k [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let x\in X and y=f(x) be closed points with residue fields equal to k. Then f is unramified at x [def-weil-unramified-morphism] if and only if the induced k-linear map on cotangent spaces [def-sc-scheme-tangent-space] \mathfrak m_y/\mathfrak m_y^2\to\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^2 is surjective.

source.place: Varieties, lemma-injective-tangent-spaces-unramified, together with the local characterization of unramified morphisms by vanishing relative differentials
